title: level of awareness of jordanian universities professors of cybersecurity: skills and challenges
core_idea: Assess the level of cybersecurity awareness among Jordanian university professors, identify key challenges they face in acquiring sufficient cybersecurity knowledge, and explore the implications for universities.
tldr: Descriptive questionnaire study of 55 professors from four Jordanian universities aiming to evaluate professors' cybersecurity awareness and identify barriers to acquiring adequate knowledge for higher education settings.
